      Add an entity

      A new organization goes through the same checks before it reaches the Atlas: no duplicate of the 197, in Massachusetts, an https site that answers, and receipts for its claims. This form drafts the entry; the command below checks it and puts it in the review queue. Nothing is written to the Atlas until the maintainer accepts it.

      python -m receipts propose new-entry.json
# checks: duplicate of the 197? in Massachusetts? site answers? then fetches its pages and writes receipts
# for its claims to out/proposed/<id>.json for review. It never edits entities.yml.

      The Atlas's own issue form and suggestion bot can feed this step too: a suggested entry gets receipts before a person reads it.
